headline: SpaceX Secures Permit for $24 Billion Texas Data Center Project
summary: Texas regulators issued an environmental permit to SpaceX for a $24 billion data center project at Starbase after ending a state-wide regulatory freeze.
why: SpaceX is an American satellite communications and space exploration company expanding its data infrastructure presence.

impacts.name: SpaceX
impacts.why: Regulatory approval allows SpaceX to proceed with multi-billion-dollar infrastructure capital expenditure.
